messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for service=responder image=responder:v2.1.3 -> routing 5%

oncall-bot: ALERT: healthcheck-failures(responder) 5xx-rate=8.4% over 5m, threshold=3% :rotating_light:

sam: seeing the alert, i'm on it. pulling logs now.

mira: i'm in meetings but I can jump in for rollout ops if needed, @sam keep me posted.

alex: quick note: v2.1.3 enabled new concurrency limiter and changed probe path to /internal/healthz (should be backward compatible)

sam: logs show repeated 502 from upstream_castle at 10:12:16. stack: "error writing to socket"

priya: paging customers? do we know impact? any errors in prod gateway?

sam: dashboard shows ~2% of requests are 5xx overall but for canary nodes it's around 9-12% and latency spike on long-poll endpoints

mira: can we revert traffic to stable? we should abort canary before it hits more hosts.

sam: creating kill-switch flag now. flag key: rollout_responder_v2.1.3_killswitch

alex: FYI the flag toggles the routing rule in the mesh: set rollout_responder_v2.1.3_killswitch=true to divert to stable

sam: applying flag via console...

sam: command: ```curl -X POST https://config.internal/api/flags -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"key":"rollout_responder_v2.1.3_killswitch","value":true}'```

deploy-bot: Feature flag updated: rollout_responder_v2.1.3_killswitch=true (applied by sam)

oncall-bot: Canary traffic diverted: responder canary nodes now 0% traffic. Healthcheck 5xx-rate dropping to 1.2% (5m window)

priya: great. any customer-facing impact windows? we should prepare a short blurb if paging happens.

mira: i can draft a short internal incident summary. need to know which customers hit long-poll endpoints during the window 10:08-10:14

sam: querying logs for client hits in that window, will paste list in a sec

sam: results: 4 high-volume customers had >500 calls each to /stream at time of spike: acme-inc, brightstart, medsys, analytics-co

alex: customer impact: intermittent 502s on streaming sessions for ~6 minutes, sessions dropped, retries succeeded for most but some client SDKs surfaced errors

priya: recommend sending proactive note to accounts for those 4 customers. cc: support, solutions eng. keep wording: short + technical + mitigation done.

mira: drafting now: "We observed transient 502 errors affecting streaming endpoints between 10:08-10:14 UTC during a canary rollout. Traffic has been diverted to stable and health metrics are normal. Root cause investigation underway; we will follow up with RCA."

sam: rolling back image on cluster for canary hosts as additional precaution. kubectl rollout undo deployment/responder --to-revision=stable-202302

deploy-bot: Rollout undo initiated for deployment/responder by sam. 3 of 3 canary pods replaced.

oncall-bot: Post-action check: responder 5xx-rate now 0.6% across fleet; streaming latency returning to baseline

alex: opening an incident ticket and assigning to eng-runtime for RCA. ticket: INC-2026-1087

priya: tagging support to draft customer emails. @sam @mira please add any follow-ups we need to include (rate limit advice, SDK retry guidance)

sam: will attach relevant logs and brief timeline to the ticket. timeline so far: 10:05 canary roll started, 10:08 healthcheck 5xx crosses threshold, 10:09 alert page, 10:10 kill-switch flipped, 10:12 canary traffic drained, 10:14 rollback complete, 10:18 metrics stable

mira: oncall handoff: i'm taking post-mitigation monitoring for next 2 hours. leaving note for night oncall if it flares again.

priya: thanks all. any lessons immediate? maybe revert probe path change until canary nodes validated separately.

alex: agree. we'll gate probe changes behind a smaller sandbox canary and add synthetic checks for long-poll paths.

sam: closing the thread for now, will update ticket INC-2026-1087 with logs and next steps. ping me if any new alerts. :white_check_mark:
